shelters.name: Atlanta Humane Society
shelters.description: No-kill animal welfare organization aiming to better lives, instill compassion, and uplift the community. Operates multiple locations across metro Atlanta including Mansell and Marietta campuses.

shelters.name: LifeLine Animal Project
shelters.description: The largest animal welfare organization in Georgia, helping over 45,000 pets annually. Manages DeKalb and Fulton County Animal Services with mission to end euthanasia of healthy and treatable animals.

shelters.name: Fulton County Animal Services
shelters.description: Open-intake shelter serving metro Atlanta and all of Fulton County. Managed by LifeLine Animal Project with about 18,000 animals annually.

shelters.name: DeKalb County Animal Services
shelters.description: DeKalb County's open-intake shelter partnering with LifeLine Animal Project to provide free veterinary care to DeKalb County residents' pets.

shelters.name: Furkids
shelters.description: Georgia's largest no-kill animal shelter and rescue organization. Operates a 24,000 square foot headquarters, cat shelter, dog shelter, and multiple adoption centers.

shelters.name: PAWS Atlanta
shelters.description: The oldest no-kill shelter in Georgia with mission to build a community of caring by people helping pets and pets helping people.

shelters.name: Angels Among Us Pet Rescue
shelters.description: 501(c)(3) nonprofit volunteer-based organization that has rescued 23,000+ animals since 2009. Operates through a network of foster homes in north metro Atlanta area.

shelters.name: Good Mews Animal Foundation
shelters.description: One of the few virtually cage-free, no-kill cat shelters in Georgia and the first in metro Atlanta. 2024 Best of Cobb Cat Adoption Center and low-cost spay/neuter clinic.

shelters.name: Humane Society of Cobb County
shelters.description: Independent 501(c)(3) no-kill shelter providing assistance to animals and pet owners in Cobb County. Recently partnered with Atlanta Humane Society family.

shelters.name: Cobb County Animal Services
shelters.description: Cobb County government animal services enforcing state laws and county ordinances, providing housing and care for homeless animals.

shelters.name: Mostly Mutts Animal Rescue
shelters.description: Voted Best Animal Rescue by Cobb County residents. 2025 grantee of The Grey Muzzle Organization supporting lifesaving efforts for senior dogs.

shelters.name: Gwinnett County Animal Welfare and Enforcement
shelters.description: Bill Atkinson Animal Welfare Center is an open-admissions shelter accepting lost, stray, or surrendered animals, striving to find adoptive families and foster homes.

shelters.name: Clayton County Humane Society & SPCA
shelters.description: No-kill animal rescue facility operating in southern metro-Atlanta. 501(c)(3) organization providing shelter, medical care, and sterilization prior to adoption.

shelters.name: Cherokee County Animal Shelter
shelters.description: Committed to providing superior service to animals and citizens through shelter work, education, and outreach programs to reduce homeless animals.

shelters.name: Humane Society for Greater Savannah
shelters.description: Savannah's primary humane society providing adoption services and animal welfare programs for the greater Savannah area.

shelters.name: Coastal Pet Rescue
shelters.description: Animal rescue organization serving the coastal Georgia region with adoption and rescue services.

shelters.name: Renegade Paws Rescue
shelters.description: Savannah-area animal rescue focused on saving and rehoming pets in the coastal Georgia region.

shelters.name: Augusta Animal Services
shelters.description: Enforces state laws and local ordinances pertaining to animal care and control, providing humane solutions through return to owner, adoption, rescue, and foster efforts.

shelters.name: PAWS Humane
shelters.description: Columbus area humane society providing adoption services and animal welfare programs for the Chattahoochee Valley region.

shelters.name: Heart of Georgia Humane Society
shelters.description: Non-profit 501(c)(3) rescuing death row animals from Macon Animal Control and Baldwin County Animal Control with goal to eliminate euthanasia through spay/neuter.

shelters.name: All About Animals Rescue
shelters.description: No-kill animal shelter in Macon that gives dogs and cats a home until permanent homes can be found.

shelters.name: Athens Area Humane Society
shelters.description: Rescues and protects companion animals by providing for their wellbeing, uniting them with loving homes, and advocating for a compassionate society. Operates adoption center and spay/neuter clinic.

shelters.name: Fayette County Humane Society
shelters.description: 501(c)(3) animal rescue organization offering dog, cat, kitten, and puppy foster, adoption, and TNVR services in Fayette County.

shelters.name: Royal Animal Refuge
shelters.description: Promotes animal welfare and responsible pet ownership, finding homes for unwanted pets and providing humane care. Launched Royal Canine & Co. pet store with proceeds supporting rescue work.

shelters.name: Georgia Humane Society
shelters.description: Statewide organization dedicated to eliminating the killing of healthy animals by implementing and promoting the no-kill equation throughout Georgia.

notes: Comprehensive collection of Georgia animal shelters, humane societies, and rescue organizations. LifeLine Animal Project is the largest animal welfare organization in Georgia, managing Fulton and DeKalb County Animal Services. PAWS Atlanta is the oldest no-kill shelter in the state. Coverage spans metro Atlanta (Fulton, DeKalb, Cobb, Gwinnett, Cherokee, Clayton, Fayette counties), Savannah, Augusta, Columbus, Macon, and Athens.
